counter_deltas: []
description: "Adoption of the Gatefall World Rule Profile chain **1.66 → 1.71**, five edges, run in order at the campaign's current anchor. No fictional time is consumed, no scene opens, and no NPC is involved. `system_state.profile_version` advances **\"1.66\" → \"1.71\"**.

**Four of the five edges are compatibility treatments and transform nothing stored.** **1.67** authored Section 6.7's derived **Combat Tier** and repointed the class trial (18.2) and the penalty zone (8.3) at it, sizing the content the System *imposes* to the Bearer's measured output rather than his System Rank label, with System Rank as a floor so nothing becomes easier; it also gave Section 18.2 five authored trial phases and struck Section 17's orphaned 'own-tier' key rule. **1.68** gave four of the five classes the progression Shadowbinder already had, binding each class's acquisition cap to a distinct Stat and doubling Devourer's fragment catalog to ten kinds. **1.69** made Section 18's title true, authoring the uncatalogued tier (Reliquary, Herald, Seam) and the Section 18.3.2 signal tally. **1.71** retired a stale deferral marker in Section 11.2. None of them touches a pool, Stat, level, XP, Rank, skill, mastery, counter, title, item, key, quest, class or candidate.

**1.69 → 1.70 is the one required migration, and its whole effect is a re-render.** Dimensional Projection's `skills_known` entry is rewritten to the 1.70 effect — projectile count as the technique's magnitude (mastery **1/2/2/3/3**, **+1 per Rank above native**), each projectile its own resolution, splittable freely across targets, resolving as a Section 6.2 **named multi-strike** with Mana paid once for the action rather than per projectile. **No counter moves:** `mastery_level` 1, `mastery_progress` 0, `successful_uses` 0, `qualifying_scenes_total` 0, `magnitude_floor` 0, all preserved exactly as stored. Projectile count is derived at use from mastery and Rank, exactly as range already was, so the edge adds no field to any ledger.

**Nothing is retroactive.** No past exchange is re-resolved, no damage figure moves, no instance is re-Ranked, no resolved kill is re-scored, and no key in inventory changes Rank. In this campaign the required migration is trivially clean: the technique has never been used and its counters stand at zero.

**Two standing consequences take effect from this anchor forward.** The Class Quest — still `offered` and unentered per `EVT-000488` — is now sized at **entry** to the Bearer's Combat Tier rather than at his System Rank, runs five authored phases under a single no-refill resource budget, and offers from a roster of eight rather than five. And the penalty zone, should the daily ever lapse, sizes the same way. Both flags that motivated `EVT-000488`'s non-promotion — **`F-022`** and **`F-023`** — are Actioned by this chain.

Separately and at the same anchor, Decision 091 (engine-level) gives Characters a disposition, beliefs that may be false, and agendas that advance on the campaign clock; eighteen campaign NPCs carry one as of this adoption. That is engine and campaign-ledger authoring rather than a profile edge, and it moves no protagonist state."
```

Engaged 2026-08-14 on a stated 2-3 day window that landed Monday or Tuesday, she had gone four days without calling; her record left the reason deliberately unsettled, to be decided from her own state rather than from whether Alexander asked. Two threads, resolved separately as independent world-facts.

**Marnie (`OBJ-16`) — 🎲 d100 91, −1 step for a subject untraceable by design, effective 71: success.** Fenn stopped looking for Marnie and started looking for who pays for the things Marnie would need, and found **a storage unit rented under a name that is not hers, paid in cash and prepaid through October — three weeks before she went quiet.** Her own read, offered without embellishment: people who are running do not prepay to October. She declined to interpret it further on the phone and wants the payment history before anyone else thinks to look. **The reveal condition is NOT met** — what actually happened to Marnie is authored nowhere (`110_WORLD_LEDGER.md` `ENT-000190`, `resolution_depth: surface`, an owner ruling) and nothing here decided it. The Hidden pointer stays `[HIDDEN] ???`.

**The warehouse (`OBJ-21`) — 🎲 d100 2, natural critical failure.** Pulling the ownership layer on Meridian Cold Storage — permits, the formation mill, filings under the same suite, the ordinary records work that is squarely her specialty — **surfaced and was traced back to her.** On Tuesday afternoon a man called her: polite, no threat, **using her licence number, and asking whether she was working for herself or for a client — already knowing the answer to the first part.** Her closing observation, delivered in the same register as her rates: he knew the licence number before he knew her name, which is not a business checking who is asking but **someone working from a list.**

**This is the exposure she named at engagement and was told to accept.** At `EVT-000374` she stated plainly that the man who already holds Alexander's real number is a real risk if her digging surfaced; that warning is recorded verbatim in `OBJ-21`. It has now materialised on **her** side rather than his — she is the one with a licence and an address in a public register.

**Alexander's answer was 'keep digging on both', delivered coldly, and did not acknowledge the exposure.** Her authored flaw fired exactly there: she states a limit once, plainly, and does not repeat it. She did not argue and did not restate it. **She changed the terms instead, as a statement of fact rather than a request** — Marnie continues as clean work, with a report **due Thursday 2026-08-20** and an explicit undertaking to call on Thursday whether or not she has anything; Meridian continues only as **work that carries no trace back to her licence** (public filings, court records, what a stranger could pull), which she stated will be slower and will probably find less. She will not file another request traceable to her licence, and will not refer anyone who would. Told 'call me actually on Thursday this time', she conceded the earlier silence without defensiveness — *'I should have called Monday and told you I had nothing yet. That one's mine.'*

No Bearer skill activated, no die against a contested action by Alexander, no pool movement. `REL-000094` moves from neutral professional engagement to a narrower one with a live grievance."

    record: ENT-000139
description: "**Woken with kisses at 06:00, thirty minutes before he asked for.** Owen registered the theft, took it, and gave up the position entirely. Alexander said *I love you, Owen Callahan* and Owen answered in kind immediately, with no run-up and no joke first — which is the observable change, since eleven days ago the same sentence needed a deflection to get through. Ruled a continuation of the pattern established at `EVT-000243`-`EVT-000245` rather than a fresh Character First.

**The regimen ran as it has twenty-six times.** Three hundred repetitions on the balcony — Owen counting badly on purpose, abandoning the squats at sixty, complaining continuously and finishing all of them — then ten kilometres south along the lakefront. He no longer falls off Alexander's pace at six kilometres and has stopped pretending that is not new. They walked the last hundred metres at his request.

**Alexander set the route deliberately easy for a man with a twelve-hour shift starting.** Owen named it out loud — *you just handled me* — agreed it was the correct call, noted that he would have pushed for hills out of spite and been useless by eleven, put it on the record that he had noticed and let it go, and then let it go. Consistent with his standing ask at `EVT-000241`: say the thing out loud, especially when he is annoyed about it.

**Quest resolved complete at 07:35**, the final objective finishing inside the 18-hour window. **Streak 11 -> 12** — not a positive multiple of seven, so the Daily Random Box is a standard single-roll box with no upgrade. Three independent pending entries created: **Ability Points +4** (Ascetic), **Status Recovery** (17 -> 18), **one Daily Random Box**. The daily awards no XP; XP unchanged at 405/2,500.

**No skill activated and no die rolled.** The regimen is the System's own fixed quest, performed for twenty-six days, and opens no formation candidate — it is neither a new repeatable method nor performed under genuine contested feedback. Health 444/444 and Mana 166/166 at cap across the span; running shifts `mana_recovery_mode` toward active in principle but both pools stood at maximum, so Sections 5.2 and 6.1.1 settle to no movement with remainders zeroed."

He named it as his own pattern rather than an accident, in the same terms he used at `EVT-000274` and about his three-day silence at `EVT-000208`-`EVT-000217`: the same avoidance, slower, so that it looks like planning. No joke arrived.

**Alexander kissed him and offered the out** — call at lunch instead, no worries. Owen took it for about two seconds, visibly, and then declined it on his own reasoning: moved to lunch it moves to after shift, after shift the desk is shut, and then it is Thursday. He thanked Alexander for giving him the out, asked him to keep doing it, and did not take this one.

**The call, 07:37.** Kesha Morrison answered at the desk. Owen identified himself as sponsor of record and confirmed the **D-Rank Ashfield contract for Saturday 2026-08-22**. She had the filing open, read back eight confirmed and two held, and asked whether it goes out at eight or ten; Owen said eight, leave the two open. **Confirmed by sponsor, eight of ten, two slots live, clearing by end of day.** She noted the posting had been sitting; Owen said that was him. **Ruled rather than rolled** (Decision 060): the confirmation was administrative and read from settled state — she held the filing, he is sponsor of record, eight names were already confirmed by text at `EVT-000483` — so nothing about it was contested. **Owen's open commitment from `EVT-000483` and `EVT-000491` is discharged.**

**Then three System settlements, all Bearer-side and invisible to Owen** (Section 14.4). **Ability Points +4 claimed and all four allocated to Vitality:** base 107 -> **111**, effective 111 -> **115** with the unchanged +4 from gear, and `maximum_health = 4 x effective Vitality` re-derives **444 -> 460**. The pool stood at cap, so the missing-amount rule leaves no deficit and Health fills to **460/460**. **Stat Passive audit: no movement** — Shrug Off is the Vitality-keyed passive and already sits [S-Rank] held, the S threshold being 80, cleared at `EVT-000360`; the System Rank C ceiling still holds it at B-Rank actual. Nothing else reads Vitality, and every damage preview is Strength-derived and unchanged.

**Daily Random Box opened on one real d100: 40**, landing 36-60 -> **System gold**, a purse at the shop's core-buy value for System Rank C, **8,500 g** (107,841 -> **116,341**).

**Crystal Key [B-Rank] bought from the Premium tab, 56,250 g** (116,341 -> **60,091**). Keys 1 -> 2; Premium 2/6 bought, the Key tab sold out until the next rotation. It opens one sealed Section 17 instance **one Rank above the Bearer's System Rank**, with its mined deposit roll fixed at 18 before the x8 B-Rank multiplier — **144 B-Rank crystals guaranteed**, against an ordinary instance's 3d6 average of about 84, and every deposit a solo Bearer's own. **Section 6.7's Combat Tier does not apply to it and that is deliberate:** the Tier sizes imposed content, the class trial and the penalty zone. This instance was chosen off a shop tab. Unentered as of this Event.

**The Dagger Mastery rune was left unbought** at 112,500 g against 60,091 remaining, and expires at the next 06:00 rotation.

Owen left for Edgewater at **07:50**, noting that Alexander had the face he gets when he has decided something, declining to ask what, and saying to tell him tonight if he wanted to."

The first thing in the instance that responded to *him* rather than to sound.

  **Ruled at the read, and flagged as a ruling rather than a quotation:** an elite's ordinary strike is Rank-honest at `rank_health / 4` for its **Rank** (150) rather than for its doubled pool, so it hits for the same base a common does. Section 6.2 does not say explicitly whether a x2 Rank Health pool feeds the damage band; *preserves Rank-honest monster damage* reads as keyed to Rank. It materially lowers the danger of every elite in the campaign and should be confirmed.

  Mana Bolt for 168, then Dimensional Projection with the Longsword -- **out of range at twelve metres and resolved as such**, the skill's mastery line reading `projectiles 1/2/2/3/3, range 5/7/10/15/20 m`, so 5 m at Novice is the skill's range and not merely its deployment band. The throw landed on the following action once they had closed, strong, for 162. Sprint broke the pincer; a legendary Exploit Pattern read established the pair's behaviour; Rupture took Elite A at x4 for **2,292**.

  **Then the tail.** Elite B rolled a **natural 99** -- a critical no modifier can remove -- for **348 through 42% reduction**, and **Shrug Off's threshold absorption fired** for only the second time in the campaign: damage only, no classified injury. **Health 464 -> 116, exactly one quarter**, which is precisely where Diehard's bonus would have been live had it been equipped. Twenty-one attacks had missed before it. Elite B killed on the following action, Rupture at x4 again. XP +1,200 (2 x 600: elite x2, underdog x2)."

description: "**Full extraction on a legendary Resonance Extraction read** -- the Pattern held across the whole face and nothing was left in the rock. **144 deposit crystals plus 14 one-per-beast drops = 158 Mana Crystals [B-Rank]**, taking the stock 40 -> **198** (148,500 g at the shop's 750 rate, of which this clear is 118,500 against 56,250 spent on the key). **3 Beast Cores [B-Rank]**, the first he has held, from both elites and the boss -- and the System shop refuses cores outright, so they convert to nothing in gold and are artificer material, which makes them Priscilla Nakamura's department on the evening he is already due in her workshop.

  **The deposit does not refill.** Section 17 is explicit that population and deposit roll once at opening and nothing respawns, so the time after a boss kill is time to mine, loot and walk, never to farm. Confirmed in play rather than assumed.

  **And one thing the System declined to price.** A strong Flux Sight appraisal of the carcass returned **no Rank and no stats -- not unidentified, uncategorised**: the System valued that death at one core, one crystal and a key and considered the matter closed, while several hundred kilos of frost-fused plating along its back read as carrying real residual mana with no category to hold it. Five pieces cut free and stored under `special`.

  **This is authored under the entailed-but-unnamed rule and is deliberately unresolved.** The profile's loot model is crystals, cores and the boss-drop table and says nothing about harvesting a carcass; the plating has been given **no value, no effect and no Rank**, because whether B-Rank plating is worth anything and whether it can be infused is exactly the beast-part question already standing unasked for `ENT-000203`. **It wants an owner ruling before it carries mechanical weight.**"
```

description: "Batch settlement for `EVT-000498`-`EVT-000502`, the first genuinely dangerous span since the B-Rank harvest trial.

  **`gatefall.skill_credit` classifies POSITIVE and the deltas are attached above** -- eleven commons, two elites and a B-Rank boss across one sealed instance. **`gatefall.skill_formation` classifies explicit `none`:** every method used was an already-ratified skill, and nothing new was demonstrated repeatedly under genuine contested feedback. `pretext_and_cover` holds at 2/3 and `nonvisual_combat_mapping` at 1/3, neither eligible, neither touched.

  **One qualifying scene, not three.** The clear is one instant dungeon and the campaign's own precedent credits one dungeon as one qualifying scene per contributing skill -- three Frozen Galleries gave Rupture three scenes at `EVT-000469`-`EVT-000476`. Splitting this clear into commons, elites and boss would have advanced five skills at once and would have been wrong.

  **One mastery advance: Flash Step, C-Rank Expert -> Master** (`mastery_level` 4 -> 5, `mastery_progress` 2 -> 0). It stood at 2/3 in its authoritative counter, and only the counter knew -- the rendered line was reconstructed at the panel from the wrong assumption and would have hidden it. At Master its modifier-step window reaches **the whole scene** (Section 7.4's utility ladder) rather than the immediate action plus three exchanges.

  **Dimensional Projection is credited for the first time in its life**: `successful_uses` 0 -> 2, `qualifying_scenes_total` 0 -> 1, `mastery_progress` 0 -> 1. Both landings were real and both confirmed the audit that ratified it -- 80 at Novice with one projectile, and 162 on a strong throw with ranked steel against a standard Mana Bolt's 168 for one less Mana. Its magnitude axis is projectile count and it does not improve until that count climbs.

  **Temporal settlement.** Anchor 2026-08-19 07:50 -> **09:25**, 1h35m. Both pools were re-derived and restored twice by level-ups (25 -> 26 -> 27), so recovery rates never governed and the Frozen Gallery's halved Mana return never bit. Final **468/468** and **170/170**; modes `resting`, remainders zero. **10 unspent stat points stand unallocated.**

  **Economy:** gold unchanged at **60,091** -- nothing was sold and no shop opened. Cash unchanged at $281,155.22. **The instance was still open at the anchor**, with 27 minutes remaining on its two hours; it closes 09:52 whether or not he leaves first. No entity, record, relationship or objective minted. **One authored object stands unruled** (`EVT-000502`, the plating)."
```

## EVT-000504 - Flash Step Breaks Through to B-Rank

```yaml
id: EVT-000504
canonical_record: REC-000079
schema_version: "0.1.6"
status: active
provenance:
  source: ruling
  game_date: "2026-08-19 09:25 -05:00"
  real_date: "2026-08-10"

importance: moderate

participants:

counter_deltas:
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.flash_step.mastery_level, delta: -2 }
  - { subject: ENT-000125, counter: skills.flash_step.rank_ascensions, delta: 1 }
participation_audits:
  - subject: ENT-000125
    result: record-updated
    record: ENT-000125
description: "**Flash Step reached Master at `EVT-000503` and the Section 7.5 threshold it created was not re-checked at that barrier.** Caught on the next exchange when the player asked why the skill rendered *complete*. The profile is explicit that a mandatory threshold is re-checked from stored state at every declared boundary precisely because the delta that should dispatch it is the one that goes unwritten -- and this is the second time this campaign has found a suppressed breakthrough offer, after Rupture and Exploit Pattern at `EVT-000468`.

  **Breakthrough taken: [C-Rank] Master -> [B-Rank] Adept.** Mastery falls Master to Adept keeping three of five levels, `mastery_progress` resets to 0, `rank_ascensions` 1 -> 2. **Gained: Through the ward** -- the step crosses a closed ward or barrier-effect rather than only a constructed one, a held read of the far side still required. **Retained: Through the barrier** at C-Rank. It still never crosses a Gate boundary, a Section 9.6 seal, or a Section 17 instance wall at any Rank.

  **Two axes were examined and neither needed a ratchet, which is the ruling worth keeping.** The Runtime first proposed authoring `duration_floor` and `mana_floor` counters to stop the whole-scene window and the 5-Mana cost regressing on the mastery reset. **Both proposals were wrong.** Section 7.2 states that mastery's duration track terminates at whole scene and that **Rank therefore saturates duration immediately at one Rank above native**; Flash Step is native D-Rank and has stood above native since `EVT-000220`, so its window is Rank-derived and the mastery reset cannot touch it. And Section 7.5 names its ratchets as **the scope and magnitude ratchets** -- cost is deliberately not among them, because breakthrough's whole price is mastery levels and cheaper casting is one of the things mastery buys. **Mana 5 -> 6 is the earned road working as designed, not a regression.** No new counter kind was created and none was needed.

  **At B-Rank the skill sits at its ceiling** -- System Rank C + 1 -- so no further ascension is available until System Rank B at level 30. Six qualifying scenes return it to Master. No fictional time consumed, no scene opened, no pool moved: Health 468/468 and Mana 170/170 unchanged, anchor held at 09:25 inside the cleared instance."
```

  **Dagger Mastery [C-Rank] Master -> [B-Rank] Adept.** Gained **Blind edge** -- the chassis bonus holds on a strike made without sight of the target, from darkness, concealment, or an attacker behind him, where an ordinary blade strike takes that condition's penalty. Multiplier `0.10 + 0.25 x 3 Ranks above native + 0.05 x (Adept - 1)` = **+0.95**, chassis x1.55 -> **x1.70**; `magnitude_floor` 55 -> 80. **This is the free version of the 112,500 g Premium rune still on the tab, and strictly better than it** -- Section 7.5 returns a breakthrough at Adept and a rune at Novice, and says so outright.

  **Twin Fang [D-Rank] Master -> [C-Rank] Adept.** Gained **Through the answer** -- the skill-enabled strike resolves against a target that has already reacted, blocked, or committed this exchange, where an ordinary follow-up would be denied the opening. Follow-up multiplier `1.00 + 0.35 x 2 + 0.15 x (3 - 1)` = **x2.00** from x1.95; Mana 4 -> 5; `magnitude_floor` 160 -> 195.

  **Resonance Extraction [E-Rank] Master -> [D-Rank] Adept.** Gained **Cores and drops** -- reads the harvestable structure of a beast core, improving extraction yield, which is the first thing this skill has ever done outside a mine and lands on the day he is carrying 49 cores into an artificer's workshop. **Scope held at 5 by the ratchet**: Section 7.2 computes 4 at D-Rank Adept and the floor takes precedence; `scope_floor` 0 -> 5.

  **Derived damage after both weapon-side ascensions**, at effective Strength 91: main-hand **192**, off-hand **173**, and Twin Fang **519 -> 557** with the off hand opening. Twin Fang stood at 446 this morning."
